highest_rated.title: Highest rated
highest_rated.rule: Every rated match, by match score.

highest_scoring.title: Highest scoring
highest_scoring.rule: Every rated match, by total goals (shootout kicks not counted).

closest_finishes.title: Closest finishes
closest_finishes.rule: Matches finishing level or by one goal, by the stored competitiveness score (final margin and time within one goal).

comebacks_late_drama.title: Comebacks and late drama
comebacks_late_drama.rule: Matches labelled Comeback or Late Drama, by match score.

hidden_gems.rule: Matches labelled Hidden Gem (4 stars or more with 2 goals or fewer), by match score.

most_chaotic.title: Most chaotic
most_chaotic.rule: Matches labelled Chaos, by the number of chaos events (red cards, penalties, equalisers, lead changes).

most_one_sided.title: Most one-sided
most_one_sided.rule: Matches labelled One-Sided, by winning margin, then lowest competitiveness.
